title: Time Complexity
description: Time complexity describes how an algorithm's running time grows as the input size increases. Common complexities include O(1), O(log n), O(n), and O(n²).

title: Space Complexity
description: Space complexity measures the additional memory required by an algorithm as the input size increases.

title: Stack
description: A stack follows the LIFO principle: Last In, First Out. Common operations include push, pop, and top.

title: Queue
description: A queue follows the FIFO principle: First In, First Out. Elements are inserted from the rear and removed from the front.
